rotation.notes: No WebSearch was used for planning; the budget is reserved for the librarians. Queries are scoped to the music category's allowed_domains in sources.json plus authoritative music-tech outlets that already produced cards in news_data.json (production-expert.com, musicbusinessworldwide.com, musically.com, digitalmusicnews.com, synthanatomy.com, kvraudio.com). Per memory: site: search tends to return evergreen pages, so the librarian should confirm recency via outlet RSS/sitemaps. 9/24 covered text-to-plugin (Amorph), ElevenLabs MCP, YouTube Music Ask Music, Pachet interview and LLM copyright triage; 9/23 covered stem separation, Snapchat Chat to Song, Sanremo AI rules and fake AI tracks on artist pages. Litigation and platform policy were heavy 9/20-9/23. Today's angles lean toward mastering/mixing, vocal synthesis, DAW-native AI (Ableton/Logic/Bitwig/FL), sample generation, real-time performance and DJ tools, AI music video, and new model releases (Lyria, Stable Audio, open weights), with Korean-market coverage.
